label: KODAK ULTRA MAX 400
source: Kodak Alaris technical data E-7023 (February 2016, revised 2/16), curves read from the PDF's vector paths (page 4)

spectral_sensitivity.unit: log10 sensitivity (reciprocal exposure, erg/cm2, for density 0.2 above D-min)

print_grain_index.note: Kodak Print Grain Index (diffuse printing, 14 in viewing distance); RMS granularity not published

notes: Approximate digitization; not supplied or endorsed by Kodak Alaris / Eastman Kodak Company. Sensitometry x = (log H - Log H Ref) / log10(2), Log H Ref -1.44 lux-seconds read from the characteristic-curve chart; density is Status M including base, made monotone by running maximum. Spectral sensitivity kept only where the curve is drawn above the chart floor (0.0); wavelengths where a curve leaves the chart are omitted, so a channel's wavelength list can be non-contiguous. Individual dye curves not published; dye_density holds only the published midscale neutral and minimum density curves. Characteristic curves: Exposure Daylight, Process C-41, Status M, Log H Ref -1.44. Spectral sensitivity: Daylight, effective exposure 1/100 s, Status M, density 0.2 above D-min. Spectral dye density: Process C-41, typical densities for a midscale neutral subject and D-min.

scan.note: fitted to 96 Lomography community scans (lomography.com/films/871945457-kodak-ultramax-400-35mm/photos, recent, pages 1-2, 2026-11-11); colours of real scans, not manufacturer data
